messages.text: The fact that you're reading this means you're still fighting. That's everything. See you in July.
I lit a candle for every stranger on this wall tonight. None of you are alone.
Grief is just love with nowhere left to go. Put it in ink. Keep them close.
One day at a time isn't a cliché — it's a lifeline. Hold on to it. I did, and I'm still here.
You are not what happened to you. You are what you choose next.
Relapse is not the end of your story. Come back. We're still here, and we're still yours.
For my little brother. I carry you everywhere I go. This one's for you.
Three years ago I was where you are right now. Keep going. It gets so much better than you can imagine from here.
To whoever needs this today: day one is the bravest thing you'll ever do. I believe in you.
